parameters.functionCode:
const company = $input.first().json.company || 'Unknown Company';

const sections = [
  'Introduction',
  'Financial Analysis', 
  'Legal Structure',
  'Market Position',
  'Products/Services',
  'Customer Analysis',
  'Supply Chain',
  'Operational Efficiency',
  'Technology Stack',
  'Intellectual Property',
  'Regulatory Compliance',
  'Legal Risks',
  'Management Team',
  'Funding History',
  'Competitive Analysis',
  'Growth Strategy',
  'SWOT Analysis',
  'Exit Potential',
  'Environmental Impact',
  'Final Assessment'
];

return sections.map(section => ({
  json: {
    company: company,
    section: section
  }
}));

parameters.name: messages

parameters.columns: company, section, status, findings, missing_data, human_tasks, confidence_score
